mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 10% signals labor market weakness, leading to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 10%, or the rate does not sustain the threshold for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous surge in demand (GDPC1) and contraction in supply (INDPRO) creates upward pressure on prices, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both GDPC1 rising and INDPRO falling, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, rising federal funds rates signal higher policy rates, reducing growth expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening cycle, or the tightening is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: Rising CPIAUCSL signals accelerating inflation, prompting market concerns about future rate hikes and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive despite rising CPIAUCSL, or the inflation effect is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in employment (PAYEMS) below 130,000 suggests labor market weakness, reducing consumer confidence and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite PAYEMS falling below 130,000, or the threshold is not met for an extended period.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand growth (GDPC1) combined with falling federal funds rates creates favorable conditions for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both GDPC1 rising and FEDFUNDS falling, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment recovery regime, a decline in UNRATE below 8% signals improving labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative despite UNRATE falling below 8% in the recovery regime, or the regime is not active.
